name: Maps
description: Maps drawn by Simon Pinkas from Natural Earth v5.1.2 (public domain), with McDonald Islands coastline from Geoscience Australia / Australian Antarctic Data Centre, 2020 (CC BY 4.0). Common place names adapted in part from Ultimate Geography 5.3, by the anki-geo contributors (text public domain). No Ultimate Geography pictures are included. © Simon Pinkas. Deck: CC BY 4.0. Countries and territories. 249-entry ISO 3166-1 reference, checked against the recorded ISO registry snapshot. Boundaries follow the documented territorial convention; explicitly undetermined areas use neutral context.
